name: Bulbasaur
flavor: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.

name: Ivysaur
flavor: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur
flavor: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Charmander
flavor: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
flavor: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

name: Charizard
flavor: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

name: Squirtle
flavor: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
flavor: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

name: Blastoise
flavor: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.

name: Caterpie
flavor: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
flavor: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Butterfree
flavor: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Weedle
flavor: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.

name: Kakuna
flavor: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

name: Beedrill
flavor: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

name: Pidgey
flavor: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Pidgeot
flavor: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

name: Rattata
flavor: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: Raticate
flavor: It uses its whis kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

name: Spearow
flavor: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

name: Fearow
flavor: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

name: Ekans
flavor: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

name: Arbok
flavor: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

name: Pikachu
flavor: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
flavor: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

name: Sandshrew
flavor: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: Sandslash
flavor: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

name: Nidoran♀
flavor: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidorina
flavor: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

name: Nidoran♂
flavor: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

name: Nidorino
flavor: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Nidoking
flavor: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.

name: Clefairy
flavor: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

name: Clefable
flavor: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Vulpix
flavor: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

name: Ninetales
flavor: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
flavor: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

name: Zubat
flavor: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

name: Golbat
flavor: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

name: Oddish
flavor: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavor: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Vileplume
flavor: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Paras
flavor: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw ing nutrients from the bug host.

name: Parasect
flavor: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

name: Venonat
flavor: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Venomoth
flavor: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

name: Diglett
flavor: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

name: Dugtrio
flavor: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Meowth
flavor: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Persian
flavor: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Psyduck
flavor: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.

name: Golduck
flavor: Often seen swim ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

name: Mankey
flavor: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.

name: Primeape
flavor: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.

name: Growlithe
flavor: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

name: Arcanine
flavor: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

name: Poliwag
flavor: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

name: Poliwrath
flavor: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

name: Abra
flavor: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

name: Kadabra
flavor: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.

name: Alakazam
flavor: Its brain can out perform a super computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.

name: Machop
flavor: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

name: Machoke
flavor: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavor: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

name: Bellsprout
flavor: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

name: Weepinbell
flavor: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

name: Victreebel
flavor: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Tentacool
flavor: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

name: Tentacruel
flavor: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

name: Geodude
flavor: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Graveler
flavor: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

name: Golem
flavor: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

name: Ponyta
flavor: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

name: Rapidash
flavor: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Slowpoke
flavor: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowbro
flavor: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.

name: Magnemite
flavor: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

name: Magneton
flavor: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

name: Farfetch’d
flavor: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

name: Doduo
flavor: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

name: Dodrio
flavor: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

name: Seel
flavor: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Dewgong
flavor: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

name: Grimer
flavor: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: Muk
flavor: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Shellder
flavor: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster
flavor: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

name: Gastly
flavor: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

name: Haunter
flavor: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an other dimension.

name: Gengar
flavor: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

name: Onix
flavor: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.

name: Drowzee
flavor: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

name: Hypno
flavor: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

name: Krabby
flavor: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

name: Kingler
flavor: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

name: Voltorb
flavor: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.

name: Electrode
flavor: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

name: Exeggcute
flavor: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Exeggutor
flavor: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

name: Cubone
flavor: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.

name: Marowak
flavor: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.

name: Lickitung
flavor: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

name: Koffing
flavor: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

name: Weezing
flavor: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

name: Rhydon
flavor: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.

name: Chansey
flavor: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.

name: Tangela
flavor: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea weed. Its vines shake as it walks.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

name: Horsea
flavor: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Seadra
flavor: Capable of swim ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Goldeen
flavor: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.

name: Seaking
flavor: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power fully up rivers and creeks.

name: Staryu
flavor: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

name: Starmie
flavor: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

name: Scyther
flavor: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

name: Jynx
flavor: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

name: Electabuzz
flavor: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

name: Magmar
flavor: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

name: Pinsir
flavor: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.

name: Tauros
flavor: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Magikarp
flavor: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Gyarados
flavor: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Lapras
flavor: A POKéMON that has been over hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

name: Ditto
flavor: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

name: Eevee
flavor: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

name: Vaporeon
flavor: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Jolteon
flavor: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.

name: Flareon
flavor: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

name: Porygon
flavor: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

name: Omanyte
flavor: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

name: Omastar
flavor: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.

name: Kabuto
flavor: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

name: Kabutops
flavor: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

name: Aerodactyl
flavor: A ferocious, pre historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

name: Snorlax
flavor: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Articuno
flavor: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Zapdos
flavor: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

name: Moltres
flavor: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

name: Dratini
flavor: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.

name: Dragonair
flavor: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

name: Dragonite
flavor: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

name: Mewtwo
flavor: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Mew
flavor: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

name: Umbreon
flavor: When agitated, this POKéMON pro tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

name: Elekid
flavor: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

name: Entei
flavor: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

name: Beldum
flavor: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.

name: Metang
flavor: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.

name: Metagross
flavor: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.

name: Rayquaza
flavor: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.

name: Gible
flavor: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

name: Gabite
flavor: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

name: Garchomp
flavor: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

name: Riolu
flavor: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Lucario
flavor: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

name: Electivire
flavor: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

name: Zorua
flavor: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavor: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Froakie
flavor: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
flavor: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja
flavor: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Sylveon
flavor: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

name: Rowlet
flavor: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Dartrix
flavor: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

name: Decidueye
flavor: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

name: Litten
flavor: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Torracat
flavor: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

name: Incineroar
flavor: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.

name: Rockruff
flavor: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

name: Lycanroc
flavor: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

name: Mimikyu
flavor: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

name: Scorbunny
flavor: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.

name: Raboot
flavor: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

name: Cinderace
flavor: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

name: Rookidee
flavor: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Corvisquire
flavor: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Corviknight
flavor: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Blipbug
flavor: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.

name: Dottler
flavor: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

name: Orbeetle
flavor: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: Rolycoly
flavor: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Carkol
flavor: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Coalossal
flavor: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Hatenna
flavor: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hattrem
flavor: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hatterene
flavor: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Milcery
flavor: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
flavor: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.

name: Dreepy
flavor: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Drakloak
flavor: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Dragapult
flavor: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Kleavor
flavor: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Sprigatito
flavor: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floragato
flavor: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Meowscarada
flavor: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Fuecoco
flavor: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Crocalor
flavor: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.

name: Skeledirge
flavor: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.

name: Quaxly
flavor: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

name: Quaxwell
flavor: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

name: Quaquaval
flavor: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

name: Lechonk
flavor: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.

name: Oinkologne
flavor: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

name: Pawmi
flavor: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavor: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot
flavor: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Fidough
flavor: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.

name: Dachsbun
flavor: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: Smoliv
flavor: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Dolliv
flavor: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
flavor: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Squawkabilly
flavor: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

name: Nacli
flavor: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Naclstack
flavor: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.

name: Garganacl
flavor: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Charcadet
flavor: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Ceruledge
flavor: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Tadbulb
flavor: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Bellibolt
flavor: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: Wattrel
flavor: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Kilowattrel
flavor: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Shroodle
flavor: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: Grafaiai
flavor: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

name: Wiglett
flavor: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wugtrio
flavor: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Finizen
flavor: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Palafin
flavor: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

name: Cyclizar
flavor: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: Terapagos
flavor: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.
